name: Z2Labs EMS
description: EM simulation pre-processor for KiCad boards, using the Z2 EMS engine (an openEMS fork with a CUDA engine). Ports, ground, stackup presets, mesh preview, simulation, field overlays.

actions.name: Z2Labs EMS
actions.description: Open the Z2Labs EMS setup for this board

actions.name: Z2Labs EMS: fab stackup
actions.description: Pick a manufacturer stackup preset (JLCPCB, ...) and write it into this board

actions.name: Z2Labs EMS: simulate
actions.description: Run the Z2 EMS engine on this board and open the result in the viewer

actions.name: Z2Labs EMS: mesh preview
actions.description: Draw the FDTD mesh the engine would use on the Z2EMS.Mesh user layer

actions.name: Z2Labs EMS: field overlay
actions.description: Overlay the current-density maps of the last run on Z2EMS.Field user layers

actions.name: Z2Labs EMS: API capability check
actions.description: Run the Spike 0 IPC capability check against the open board (non-destructive, all changes are dropped)
